segments.caption: A static, intricate sculpture made of wooden toothpicks with red tips stands upright on a white surface, its spiral and layered structure remaining completely still across the frames.
A tall, spiral structure made of unlit matchsticks is ignited at the top, and a bright, rapidly spreading flame consumes the entire tower, causing it to glow intensely and emit smoke as it burns.

A tall, spiraling tower of matchsticks ignites and rapidly burns from the top down, with flames growing larger and more intense as they consume the structure, casting a warm, flickering glow on the surrounding environment.

A spiral structure made of sticks or matchsticks is engulfed in bright, dancing flames, burning steadily as the camera slowly pulls back to reveal the full height of the fiery sculpture against a warm, dimly lit background.
A tall, spiraling tower of matches is engulfed in flames, with the fire actively consuming the structure from the top down, casting a warm, flickering glow on the surrounding walls and floor.

A tall, spiraling structure made of matchsticks is engulfed in flames, with fire actively consuming the wooden sticks from the bottom upward, causing the structure to visibly collapse and deform as it burns.
A fire rapidly intensifies, consuming a stack of matches and igniting the surrounding area with bright, dancing flames.

A small, intense fire burns vigorously on a reflective surface, its bright yellow and orange flames dancing and flickering as they consume a pile of what appears to be burnt matchsticks or similar combustible material. The scene is bathed in the fire's warm glow, casting long shadows against a plain, dimly lit background wall.
